nuggets.text: Head coach Tosh Lupoi is a former Golden Bears defensive lineman who led Cal's defensive line in tackles in 2003.
Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele holds Hawaii's high school record with 10,653 career passing yards, topping Dillon Gabriel's mark.
The Golden Bears last played at Syracuse in 1967, so Saturday is their first trip there in 59 years.
California Memorial Stadium sits on the Hayward Fault, which runs under the field nearly from goal post to goal post.
Tightwad Hill, overlooking Memorial Stadium, draws fans hoping to watch Golden Bears games for free.
Oski the Bear debuted in 1941, and the students inside the suit traditionally keep their identities secret.
The Golden Bears beat Stanford in 1982 on The Play: five laterals, a run through the Stanford band, and a flattened trombone.
President John F. Kennedy spoke at Memorial Stadium in 1962 to an above-capacity crowd of 88,000.
Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele threw for 3,454 yards and started all 13 games for the Golden Bears in 2025.
Adam Mohammed carried 28 times for 120 yards in the Golden Bears' opener against UCLA.
